text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation, where machines do repetitive tasks that people used to do. This can save time and reduce mistakes. Many companies also use productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, to help employees work faster and better. However, AI does not replace people completely. In fact, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common, where workers use AI to support their decisions and creativity. Of course, these changes mean some jobs will disappear while new ones appear. Therefore, workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive in a rapidly changing job market.
